must.title: Security Compliance
must.description: Ensure the modernized system complies with security standards.
must.metric: Zero critical vulnerabilities in security scans
acceptance_criteria: Security scans reveal no critical vulnerabilities.
Access controls are implemented according to policy.

must.title: Reliability
must.description: The system should be reliable and available with minimal downtime.
acceptance_criteria: Automated failover mechanisms are in place.
Downtime incidents are resolved within SLA timeframes.

should.title: System Performance
should.description: The system must perform efficiently under expected load conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Performance tests meet the response time metric.
System load does not exceed 75% CPU utilization under peak conditions.
Performance degradation is less than 5% during stress testing.
should.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99

should.title: Usability
should.description: The modernized system should be user-friendly and intuitive.
acceptance_criteria: User testing results in a satisfaction score above 85%.
The user interface is consistent and intuitive.
Help and documentation are readily accessible.

should.title: Portability
should.description: The system should be portable across different environments.
acceptance_criteria: The system deploys successfully in all target environments.
Deployment scripts are automated and error-free.
